title: Chapter 143 — The DOA: Dead on Arrival
intro: Brand new appliance, plugged in, does not work. The ultimate delivery nightmare.

sections.title: The DOA Protocol
sections.content:
Do not troubleshoot for 20 minutes while the customer watches you poke at their brand new $3,000 appliance. Apologize. Take immediate ownership. Present options.

Option A: expedited replacement — pull from floor stock if needed. Same model, different serial number, delivered within 24-48 hours. Option B: full refund if they have lost confidence in the product. Option C: equivalent substitute from stock if the same model is not available.

The speed of your response in the first 60 minutes determines whether this customer ever buys from you again.

sections.title: The Recovery
sections.content:
After the replacement is delivered and working: follow up the same day. Follow up again in 48 hours. Send a handwritten note apologizing for the inconvenience. Consider a small gesture — a water filter, an accessory, a gift card for their trouble.

A DOA handled with speed and grace can actually strengthen the relationship. The customer remembers how you responded, not just what went wrong.
